create_cachedict_with_ram_and_disk: create a CacheDict with a folder path and keep_in_ram=True to cache data in both RAM and disk
write_data_to_cachedict: write numpy arrays or tensors to a CacheDict using the write context manager to persist data on disk
read_data_from_cachedict: read cached data from a CacheDict by key which loads from RAM cache or disk as needed
delete_cachedict_entry: delete a specific key from a CacheDict which removes it from RAM and overwrites the JSONL entry
clear_cachedict: clear all entries from a CacheDict removing all RAM data and disk files while preserving the folder
